article_title: Pri-microRNA-124 rs531564 polymorphism minor allele increases the risk of pulmonary artery hypertension by abnormally enhancing proliferation of pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pISO luciferase reporter (Promega)
cell_context: human pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells (PASMCs)
mutant_design: site-directed mutation of the predicted miR-124 response element in the GRB2 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: GRB2 mRNA and protein measured by qPCR and Western blot after miR-124 mimic/inhibitor or GRB2 siRNA
evidence_note: GRB2 WT 3UTR reporter showed substantially lower luciferase with miR-124 mimic; the cognate mutant reporter and scramble controls did not show that repression. Methods and result were verified in the original PDF (pp. 4-5).

article_title: p38α mitogen-activated protein kinase depletion and repression of signal transduction to translation machinery by miR-124 and -128 in neurons.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pCI-FLuc firefly reporter plus Renilla luciferase transfection control
cell_context: HEK293 cells; orthogonal neuronal validation in primary mouse cerebellar granule cells
mutant_design: site-directed mutation of the miR-124 seed sequence in the full-length p38α/MAPK14 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: endogenous p38α protein decreased after pre-miR-124 in HEK293 cells and increased after miR-124 antagonism in primary cerebellar granule neurons
evidence_note: The full-length p38α 3UTR was placed downstream of firefly luciferase. miR-124 reduced the WT reporter, whereas the reporter carrying the cognate miR-124 seed mutation was no longer repressed; four independent reporter experiments were reported. Methods and results were verified in the original full text.

article_title: Bioengineered miR-124-3p prodrug selectively alters the proteome of human carcinoma cells to control multiple cellular components and lung metastasis in vivo.
article_status: corrected; PMID 37655312 / DOI 10.1016/j.apsb.2023.07.002 changes a mislabeled Fig. 4A image and states conclusions are unaffected
reporter_vector: pEZX-MT06 dual-luciferase reporter (GeneCopoeia)
cell_context: HEK293 reporter assay; A549, 143B and MG-63 endogenous-protein contexts
mutant_design: three constructs disrupting the proximal MRE1, distal MRE2, or both sites in the 0-1024-nt PLEC 3UTR insert
orthogonal_endogenous_support: PLEC immunoblot; approximately 80% protein reduction in A549 after bioengineered miR-124-3p
evidence_note: miR-124-3p inhibited the WT PLEC 3UTR reporter by more than 40%; repression persisted after proximal-site mutation but disappeared when distal MRE2 was mutated. The 2023 correction concerns a representative Fig. 4A cell image, not the Fig. 3 reporter evidence.

article_title: MicroRNA-124 Promotes Intestinal Inflammation by Targeting Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor in Crohn's Disease.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: luciferase reporter carrying the human AHR 3UTR
cell_context: Caco-2 and HT-29 human intestinal epithelial cell lines
mutant_design: mutation of the nucleotides in the miR-124 seed-matching sequence of the human AHR 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: AHR protein changed inversely with pre-miR-124 and anti-miR-124 in Caco-2 and HT-29 cells; inverse miR-124/AHR protein relationship was also observed in Crohn's disease colon tissue and intestinal epithelial cells
evidence_note: Pre-miR-124 repressed the human AHR 3UTR reporter and anti-miR-124 increased it; both effects were largely abolished after mutation of the cognate seed-matching nucleotides (Figure 2F). Endogenous AHR protein evidence was reported in two human intestinal epithelial cell lines and patient material.

article_title: Hepatitis C virus-induced up-regulation of microRNA-155 promotes hepatocarcinogenesis by activating Wnt signaling.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pGL3 firefly luciferase reporter plus pRL-TK Renilla normalization vector
cell_context: HEK293 reporter cells overexpressing miR-155; orthogonal primary human hepatocytes and Huh7 cells
mutant_design: four-nucleotide mutation in the miR-155-binding site within an approximately 300-bp APC 3UTR insert
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-155 overexpression markedly reduced endogenous APC protein in primary hepatocytes and Huh7 cells; APC mRNA and miR-155 were inversely correlated in HCV-infected patient samples
evidence_note: miR-155 significantly repressed pGL3-APC-3UTR, whereas mutation of four nucleotides in the cognate miR-155-binding site completely abrogated suppression. Reporter assays were performed 48 h after cotransfection in HEK293 cells and normalized to pRL-TK Renilla; the original article reports P<0.05.

article_title: MiR-155 promotes colitis-associated intestinal fibrosis by targeting HBP1/Wnt/β-catenin signalling pathway.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pYr-MirTarget luciferase vector carrying human HBP1 3UTR
cell_context: HEK293T reporter cells; CCD-18Co human colonic fibroblasts; human colonic tissue and mouse colitis models
mutant_design: QuikChange site-directed mutation of the predicted miR-155-binding site in the human HBP1 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: HBP1 mRNA and protein changed inversely after miR-155 mimic or inhibitor in CCD-18Co cells; patient colonic tissue and mouse-model evidence supported the miR-155/HBP1 axis
evidence_note: miR-155 mimic significantly inhibited the WT human HBP1 3UTR reporter, whereas the cognate mutant reporter showed no miR-155 inhibitory effect. An independent 2014 original study (PMID 24675724; DOI 10.1093/cvr/cvu070) also found that mutation of conserved HBP1 site B almost rescued miR-155-mediated reporter suppression and documented the exact mature miR-155 sequence.

article_title: MicroRNA-155-5p inhibition alleviates irritable bowel syndrome by increasing claudin-1 and ZO-1 expression.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pGL3-CLDN1-3UTR dual-luciferase reporter
cell_context: NCM460 human intestinal epithelial cells; human IBS-D colon samples and TNBS mouse model
mutant_design: four-nucleotide mutation in the predicted miR-155-5p-binding site of the CLDN1 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-155-5p overexpression reduced endogenous CLDN1 protein in NCM460 cells; inverse expression was observed in human IBS-D colon samples, with inhibitor response in the mouse model
evidence_note: In NCM460 cells, 40 nM miR-155-5p markedly suppressed the WT CLDN1 3UTR reporter after 48 h, while the four-nucleotide cognate-site mutation caused complete loss of suppression. The article explicitly names the 5p mature arm and reports P<0.01 for the reporter experiment.

article_title: The identification of novel targets of miR-16 and characterization of their biological functions in cancer cells.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: p-MIR-report firefly luciferase plasmid plus beta-galactosidase transfection control
cell_context: A549 human lung adenocarcinoma cells; discovery expression profiling also used MCF-7, HeLa, SW480 and HEK-293 cells
mutant_design: point mutations in the CDS2 3UTR nucleotides complementary to bases 2-8 of the mature miR-16 seed
orthogonal_endogenous_support: CDS2 mRNA was downregulated after pre-miR-16 in the multi-cell-line microarray screen; CDS2-specific endogenous protein validation was not reported
evidence_note: The entire human CDS2 3UTR was cloned downstream of firefly luciferase. Pre-miR-16 significantly repressed the WT reporter, anti-miR-16 increased its activity, and seed-complementary mutations almost fully rescued repression in A549 cells; three independent experiments were reported with P<0.001 for the WT/mutant panel.

article_title: Knockdown of lncRNA X inactive specific transcript (XIST) radiosensitizes non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cells through regulation of miR-16-5p/WEE1 G2 checkpoint kinase (WEE1) axis.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pGL3-basic WEE1 3UTR luciferase reporter with dual-luciferase readout
cell_context: H838 and A549 human NSCLC cells; 31 paired human NSCLC and adjacent-tissue samples
mutant_design: cognate substitutions within the miR-16-5p seed-matching sequence at WEE1 3UTR positions 265-271
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-16-5p mimic significantly reduced endogenous WEE1 mRNA and protein in H838 and A549 cells; miR-16-5p and WEE1 mRNA were inversely correlated in 31 human NSCLC samples
evidence_note: In both H838 and A549 cells, miR-16-5p reduced the WT WEE1 3UTR reporter to approximately 0.4 of control, whereas the cognate mutant reporter remained near control and showed no significant miR-16-5p effect. Reporters were read 48 h after cotransfection; experiments were repeated at least three times. The older PMID 24317448 study supports WT 3UTR regulation but was not relied on for mutant rescue.

article_title: R-2HG downregulates ERα to inhibit cholangiocarcinoma via the FTO/m6A-methylated ERα/miR16-5p/YAP1 signal pathway
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: psiCHECK-2 carrying a 500-bp YAP1 3UTR fragment downstream of Renilla luciferase
cell_context: HuCCT1 and QBC939 human cholangiocarcinoma cells
mutant_design: cognate substitutions in the miR-16-5p seed-matching site beginning at YAP1 3UTR nucleotide 161; WT UGCUGCUG changed to mutant GGATCCG
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-16-5p overexpression reduced endogenous YAP1 protein and cell growth in HuCCT1 cells; miR-16-5p inhibition increased YAP1 protein and growth in QBC939 cells; Ago2 RIP and reciprocal ERα/miR-16-5p rescue experiments supported the axis
evidence_note: Overexpressed miR-16-5p reduced the WT YAP1 3UTR reporter in HuCCT1 cells from approximately 1.0 to 0.5, but did not reduce the cognate mutant. Reciprocally, miR-16-5p inhibitor increased WT reporter activity in QBC939 cells from approximately 1.1 to 1.45, but did not significantly affect the mutant. Reporter activity was measured 36 h after transfection; Figure 5 sequence alignment and methods were inspected.

article_title: Deregulation of the miR-16-KRAS axis promotes colorectal cancer
article_status: journal article with author correction DOI 10.1038/s41598-021-99119-w; correction replaces duplicated invasion images in Figure 4D and does not affect the Figure 3 luciferase evidence
reporter_vector: pMIR-REPORT containing the entire human KRAS 3UTR; firefly luciferase normalized to beta-galactosidase
cell_context: SW480 and Caco2 human colorectal cancer cells
mutant_design: cognate seed-recognizing sequence changed from TGCTGCT to ACGACGA in the full-length KRAS 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: pre-miR-16 reduced endogenous KRAS protein in SW480 and HT-29 cells, whereas anti-miR-16 increased KRAS protein in Caco2 cells; KRAS mRNA was not significantly changed; miR-16-resistant KRAS ORF rescued cellular and xenograft phenotypes
evidence_note: At 24 h, pre-miR-16 reduced the WT reporter in SW480 cells from 1.0 to approximately 0.25, whereas the mutant was unaffected. Anti-miR-16 reciprocally increased WT activity in Caco2 cells from 1.0 to approximately 2.8, whereas the mutant was unaffected. Reporter assays were performed in triplicate and repeated several times. The 2021 correction concerns Figure 4D invasion images, not Figure 3E reporter data.

article_title: Oncogenic Wip1 Phosphatase is Inhibited by miR-16 in the DNA Damage Signaling Pathway
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pRL Renilla reporter containing the 1.1-kbp human WIP1/PPM1D 3UTR; normalized to firefly luciferase
cell_context: U2OS human osteosarcoma cells
mutant_design: deletion of six nucleotides recognized by miR-16 from the cognate site in the 1.1-kbp WIP1 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: pre-miR-16 decreased endogenous Wip1 protein and antagomir-16 increased it in U2OS cells; miR-16 also reduced Wip1 protein in MCF-7 cells and Wip1 restoration rescued mammosphere phenotypes
evidence_note: Pre-miR-16 reduced the WT WIP1 3UTR reporter by approximately 75%, while antagomir-16 increased it by approximately 50%. Deleting six nucleotides of the cognate site almost completely abolished both effects. Renilla activity was measured 48 h after transfection in U2OS cells and normalized to firefly luciferase.

article_title: Regulatory function and mechanism research for m6A modification WTAP via SUCLG2-AS1- miR-17-5p-JAK1 axis in AML
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: dual-luciferase reporters carrying WT or mutant human JAK1 3UTR sequence
cell_context: HEK293T reporter cells; THP-1 and HL-60 human AML cells for endogenous validation
mutant_design: cognate substitutions in the predicted miR-17-5p seed-matching sequence of the JAK1 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: Ago2 RIP enriched miR-17-5p and JAK1; miR-17-5p mimic/inhibitor reciprocally changed endogenous JAK1 mRNA and protein in THP-1 and HL-60 cells
evidence_note: miR-17-5p mimic significantly repressed JAK1-WT (P<0.001) but did not significantly repress JAK1-MUT. The original Figure 7 displays the WT/MUT site alignment; methods explicitly name JAK1-3UTR (miR-17-5p)-WT and -MUT constructs. Experiments were independently repeated at least three times.

article_title: MicroRNAs 17-5p-20a-106a control monocytopoiesis through AML1 targeting and M-CSF receptor upregulation
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: luciferase reporters carrying human AML1/RUNX1 target 3UTR or the 60-bp AML1short WT/mutant insert
cell_context: human hematopoietic progenitor-derived monocytic cultures
mutant_design: four-base substitution in the shared miR-17-5p/20a/106a cognate site of the 60-bp human AML1short 3UTR insert
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-17-5p/20a/106a transfection suppressed endogenous AML1 protein and anti-miRNAs produced reciprocal effects during human monocytopoiesis
evidence_note: The original Figure 3 shows approximately 80% repression by the target AML1 3UTR, loss of repression with the AML1short mutant, and WT/MUT-selective anti-miR-17-5p response. Because the mutant site is shared by the identical seed family, exact miR-17-5p specificity is supported by the individually tested anti-miR-17-5p arm rather than inferred from pooled treatment alone.

article_title: The regulatory and predictive functions of miR-17 and miR-92 families on cisplatin resistance of non-small cell lung cancer
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: psiCHECK-2 dual-luciferase reporter carrying the 1531-bp human CDKN1A 3UTR (WT or MUT)
cell_context: A549 and cisplatin-resistant A549/DDP human lung adenocarcinoma cells
mutant_design: both miR-17-family sites in the 1531-bp CDKN1A 3UTR were changed in the chemically synthesized mutant construct
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-17 mimic reduced endogenous CDKN1A mRNA and protein in A549/DDP cells; a CDKN1A site-blocking mRNA protector rescued reporter activity and endogenous phenotypes
evidence_note: MiR-17 mimic reduced the WT CDKN1A 3UTR reporter to approximately half of control, whereas the two-site mutant remained near control. The original Figure 2 provides the two WT/mutant alignments; three biological replicates were reported, and an independent mRNA-protector experiment blocked the same site-dependent silencing.

article_title: HIF-1α downregulates miR-17/20a directly targeting p21 and STAT3: a role in myeloid leukemic cell differentiation.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pMIR-REPORT firefly luciferase reporter plus pRL-SV40 Renilla internal control
cell_context: HEK293T reporter cells; U937T human AML cells for endogenous protein validation
mutant_design: 3-bp substitutions at mature-miRNA-facing positions 2, 4, and 6 in the second site (M2) or both conserved sites (M1+M2)
orthogonal_endogenous_support: ectopic miR-17 reduced endogenous STAT3 protein in U937T HIF-1α cells by Western blot
evidence_note: The full-length human STAT3 3UTR containing sites at nucleotides 157-163 and 447-453 was repressed by an exact miR-17 mimic in HEK293T cells. Repression was clearly abrogated by the M2 single-site mutant and especially by the M1+M2 double mutant; three independent experiments were reported. Separate U937T experiments showed reduced endogenous STAT3 protein after miR-17 expression.

article_title: p53 Mutation Directs AURKA Overexpression via miR-25 and FBXW7 in Prostatic Small Cell Neuroendocrine Carcinoma.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: luciferase reporters carrying WT or cognate-site-mutant FBXW7 3UTR
cell_context: FGC, PC-3 and NCI-H660 human prostate cancer or small-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma cells
mutant_design: mutation of the predicted miR-25 cognate site in the FBXW7 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-25 perturbation reciprocally changed endogenous FBXW7 mRNA or protein and the downstream AURKA pathway in human prostate cancer cells
evidence_note: Exogenous miR-25 reduced the WT FBXW7 3UTR reporter by approximately 50%, whereas the cognate-site-mutant reporter showed no obvious response. The original article, figure text and publication-notice status were inspected.

article_title: MicroRNAs/TP53 feedback circuitry in glioblastoma multiforme.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pGL3 luciferase reporters carrying WT or seed-region-mutant MDM2 3UTR
cell_context: U87 human glioblastoma cells
mutant_design: mutation of the predicted miR-25 and miR-32 seed-responsive regions in the MDM2 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-25 or miR-32 reduced endogenous MDM2 mRNA and protein with p53 and p21 accumulation
evidence_note: miR-25 repressed the reporter bearing WT MDM2 3UTR relative to scrambled control, whereas mutation of the responsive seed region removed the reporter response. Original PNAS methods, results and figure text were inspected.

article_title: Negative regulation of the tumor suppressor p53 gene by microRNAs.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pRL-TK Renilla reporter carrying WT TP53 3UTR or pRL-p53UTRmut
cell_context: 293T human embryonic kidney cells; endogenous validation in HCT116, A549 and H929 cells
mutant_design: TP53 3UTR positions 92-98 changed from TGCAATA to ACGTTAT
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-25 reduced endogenous TP53 mRNA by approximately 85% and reduced p53 protein; miR-25 inhibition increased p53 in three human cell lines
evidence_note: miR-25 repressed the WT TP53 3UTR reporter, while the cognate mutation abolished miR-25 regulation without abolishing miR-30d regulation. Construct methods and results were verified in the original full text.

article_title: CPEB2, CPEB3 and CPEB4 are coordinately regulated by miRNAs recognizing conserved binding sites in paralog positions of their 3'-UTRs.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pGL3-Control luciferase reporter
cell_context: HEK293T and SK-N-BE human cells
mutant_design: point mutations in the cognate miR-92 target motif of CPEB2 Mut92; construct sequence-verified
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-92 LNA raised WT reporter activity to mutant levels; miR-92 overexpression reduced reporter mRNA; endogenous CPEB2 mRNA increased after miR-92 depletion
evidence_note: The final portion of the human CPEB2 3UTR from base 2497 onward was amplified from human genomic DNA. miR-92 overexpression reduced WT luciferase activity by about 30%, while the CPEB2 Mut92 reporter lost the response; reciprocally, miR-92 LNA raised WT to mutant levels without an analogous mutant effect. The original methods, results and Figure 4 were inspected.

article_title: miR-92a-3p Exerts Various Effects in Glioma and Glioma Stem-Like Cells Specifically Targeting CDH1/beta-Catenin and Notch-1/Akt Signaling Pathways.
article_status: journal article; no linked correction, expression of concern, or retraction notice identified
reporter_vector: pGL3-Control luciferase reporter
cell_context: U87 and U251 human glioma cells; U87s and U251s glioma stem-like cells in the broader study
mutant_design: cognate mutations in the predicted miR-92a-3p-binding site of the CDH1 3UTR
orthogonal_endogenous_support: miR-92a-3p inhibition increased endogenous CDH1 mRNA and protein in human glioma cells
evidence_note: The WT or mutant CDH1 3UTR sequence contained the predicted miR-92a-3p site, and the article specifies the mature inhibitor and mimic sequences. In glioma cells, miR-92a-3p inhibition significantly increased the WT reporter, whereas the cognate mutant reporter was unchanged; endogenous CDH1 mRNA and protein changed consistently. Methods, results and Figure 4 were inspected.
